'''Blitzkrieg Cup 2on2 edition''' is a [[2on2]] tournament that is taking place on saturday, 5 April [[2025]]. It will be played on a freshly designed map by {{player|kwon|flag=de}} called '''[[cot2v2]]'''. Join us on [https://discord.gg/79APnzeQ Blitzkrieg Discord].
{{#ev:youtube|IlBQvgGrdPQ|}}
== Format ==
* Date: April 5
* Single-Elimination Bracket
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}
* Other maps are not allowed
